raw_text: Raj Ayush UG/PG Counselling Board OFFICE OF CHAIRMAN, COUNSELING BOARD (UG/PG AYUSH Counseling Board, Govt. of Rajasthan) 212-214 AYUSH BHAWAN Sector-26 Pratap Nagar, Jaipur 302033 Toggle navigation Read Instructions Home Contact Us Counselling Information Provisional Seat Allocation List (Counselling, Round 1) for MD/MS Ayurveda Admissions – 2026-27 TENTATIVE REVISED VACANT SEAT MATRIX FOR SVR-2nd ROUND AIQ QUOTA (Private), STATE QUOTA ( Govt. & Private) & NRI QUOTA (Private) SESSION 2026-27 as on 23.11.2026 - 05.00 PM NOTICE REGARDING WITHDRAWAL/SURRENDER OF ALLOTTED SEATS FOR THE ACADEMIC SESSION 2026–27 (LAST DATE: 23.11.2026 UP TO 05:00 PM) Fee Structure of Participating Institutes INFORMATION BOOKLET BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BNYS ADMISSION COUNSELLING-2026-27 Our Gallery Welcome to Rajasthan Neet Ayush UG / PG Counselling Board - 2026 Click here for Counselling 2026-27 For Admission in AYUSH Under Graduate Courses viz. BAMS, BHMS BUMS & BNYS through NEET-2026 and AYUSH PG Courses (M.D./M.S.) (Ayurved) & M.D. (Homoeopathy) in AYUSH educational institutions in Rajasthan on state quota seats and NRI seats for the Session 2026-27, a State level Counseling Board has been constituted by the Government of Rajasthan under the Chairmanship of Dr. Batti Lal Bairwa, Additional Director, Department of Ayurveda, Govt of Rajasthan, Wide Order No. प. 25 (7) आयु./ 2023-1291 dated 26 July 2024. Aspirants will be required to get registered themselves for admission counseling for the Session 2026-27 in AYUSH colleges located in Rajasthan on the website of Counseling Board on the Dates as per Schedule after declaration of result of NEET-2026.
